title_en: Fall 2026 Doctoral Dissertation Review: Results Due Tuesday, December 29, 2026
summary: Doctoral students in the Department of Aerospace Engineering who are taking their dissertation review in Fall 2026 must complete the initial, intermediate and final reviews, and submit the review result documents by Tuesday, December 29, 2026. They must inform the department office of the date, time and place of each review and of any changes. They must then submit the dissertation PDF online through the Central Library website between January 15 and February 1, 2027 (14:00), and submit the online submission confirmation and the original approval page to the department office (Room 117) within the same period.
applies_to: Doctoral students in the Department of Aerospace Engineering who are undergoing doctoral dissertation review in Fall 2026 (2026학년도 2학기). Completing the review and submitting the dissertation is mandatory for receiving the degree. The review period extension request applies only to doctoral students who will postpone their review to the next semester. The thesis submission deadline extension request applies only to students admitted in 2013 or earlier for whom 6 years have passed since completing the doctoral program (excluding military service) and who wish to extend by 2 more years, and to students admitted in 2014 or later for whom 5 years have passed since completing the doctoral program (excluding military service).

conditions: The dissertation presentation and the dissertation itself should, in principle, be in English.
The initial review is held as a public presentation.
All five committee members must attend the review; a written review may not replace attendance.
If the review is held online, the identity of participants must be strictly verified.
The preliminary review report must cover an initial, an intermediate and a final review; the preliminary review (initial and intermediate) must be held at least twice.
The dissertation title and writing language stated in the review result documents become the final title and language and cannot be changed later.
One library copy of the dissertation must include an approval page bearing the seal (stamp) or signature of every committee member.
Only the online PDF is submitted; no bound copy is submitted.
No submission or correction is possible after the online submission deadline.
A dissertation is accepted only within the submission period and cannot be replaced after submission.
Students who do not submit the dissertation cannot receive the degree and will be excluded from the list of degree recipients.
The online submission confirmation can be printed only after any unreturned library books and overdue fees are fully cleared.
Submission by a proxy is allowed, but the formal requirements (approval page, consent form, etc.) must be met.
The review period extension request is only for doctoral students postponing their review to the next semester.

A thesis submission deadline extension may be requested by students admitted in 2013 or earlier for whom 6 years have passed since program completion (excluding military service) and who wish to extend by 2 years, and by students admitted in 2014 or later for whom 5 years have passed since program completion (excluding military service).
Under department rules, a dissertation may in principle be submitted up to 5 years after program completion, not counting military service.
steps: Read the attachments (result document forms, cover and approval page sample, dissertation writing guidelines, and public presentation schedule); their contents were not read for this translation.
Set your own review schedule and contact all committee members yourself, especially external professors (from other departments or universities), by email in advance to confirm the dates.
As soon as the initial and final review dates are set, inform the department office of the date, time and place, and inform it again of any change (the contact is in the original notice).

Initial review: prepare your personal details (the "Personal Information of Doctoral Dissertation Review Candidate" already submitted with your registration documents) and the review copy of your dissertation.
Initial review: deliver the review copy of the dissertation directly to each committee member at least 7 days before the review.
Initial review: give the review as a public presentation (see the presentation schedule attachment, updated in real time).
Intermediate review: in consultation with your professor, hold an intermediate review between the initial and final reviews.

Final review: prepare the "Doctoral Dissertation Review Result Document Form" (Attachment 1) and the approval page (Attachment 2), and deliver the review copy of the dissertation directly to each committee member at least 7 days before the review.

Final review: print the result forms: 1 copy of the preliminary review result report (initial, intermediate and final reviews) for the committee chair; 5 copies of the oral examination score sheet with your name and the final review date, placed at the committee members' seats in advance; 5 copies of the ballot with your name, placed at the members' seats in advance; 1 copy of the review summary, written in advance with your professor, for the chair; 1 copy of the review result table for the committee; and the abstract (with student ID and name at the top; a foreign-language abstract if the main text is Korean, a Korean abstract if it is in a foreign language).

Final review: on the day, print 2–3 approval pages dated "Submitted / November 2026" and "Approved / December 2026", bring an ink pad, and obtain the seal (stamp) or signature of every committee member.
Submit the review result report documents to the department office (Room 117) by Tuesday, December 29, 2026.
If applicable, submit a review period extension request or a thesis submission deadline extension request by Tuesday, December 29, 2026.

Check your English name (including upper and lower case) on the SNU portal (http://my.snu.ac.kr) → Student Administration → Personal Information → Basic Personal Information (enter or correct your English name).
Follow the separate notice on the submission method to be issued later and the Central Library's official instructions.

Submit the dissertation PDF online between January 15 and February 1, 2027 (14:00) via the Central Library website (http://library.snu.ac.kr) → "Library Services" (도서관서비스) → "Online Dissertation Submission" (학위논문 온라인 제출).

After submitting the PDF, and after clearing any unreturned books or overdue fees, print the online dissertation submission confirmation from the Central Library website → "Library Services" (도서관서비스) → "Online Dissertation Submission" (학위논문온라인제출) → "Archive" (자료실).
Submit the online dissertation submission confirmation and the original approval page to the department office (Room 117) by Monday, February 1, 2027, 14:00.
translation:
Title: Fall 2026 Doctoral Dissertation Review Guide (Result Report: by Tue, 12/29)

This is the guide to doctoral dissertation review in the Department of Aerospace Engineering for Fall 2026.

As soon as your initial and final review schedules are decided, please inform the department staff member (contact details are in the original notice) of the schedule (date and time) and place, and please also inform them if the schedule or place changes.

As set out below, the final review must be held by Tuesday, December 29, 2026 at the latest (deadline for submitting the result report documents).

[Doctoral Dissertation Review]

1. Period: from acceptance of the review application documents to Tuesday, December 29, 2026 (the period in which you must complete everything from the initial review to the final review).
- Doctoral dissertation reviews are scheduled and held individually. As a principle, the initial review is held at the beginning of the semester and the final review at the end of the semester (December). As a principle, the dissertation presentation and writing are in English.

2. Review preparation and procedure

1) Initial review
(1) Documents to prepare for the initial review:
- Your background and personal details (the "Personal Information of Doctoral Dissertation Review Candidate" from the registration documents already submitted) and the review copy of the dissertation.
* Submit the review copy directly to the committee members at least 7 days before the review.
(2) Students must contact the committee members themselves (especially external professors from other departments and other universities) in advance by email or similar to confirm the schedule.
(3) Once the final review schedule is set, please inform the department staff member in advance.

2) Final review
(1) Documents to prepare for the final review: prepare the "Doctoral Dissertation Review Result Document Form" (박사논문심사결과서류양식) <see Attachment 1> and the "approval page" (인준지) <see Attachment 2> yourself.
* Submit the review copy directly to the committee members at least 7 days before the review.
(2) Students must contact the committee members themselves (especially external professors from other departments and other universities) in advance by email or similar to confirm the schedule.
(3) How to complete the "Doctoral Dissertation Review Result Form" <Attachment 1> used at the final review:
① Doctoral preliminary review result report
- Print 1 copy for confirmation by the committee chair.
- All five committee members must attend. (A written review may not be substituted; for online reviews, verify participants' identity thoroughly.)
- The preliminary review result report must include the initial, intermediate and final reviews. For example, if the initial review was on November 20 and the final review on December 20, there must be an intermediate review around the date in between, arranged in consultation with your professor. In other words, the preliminary review (initial and intermediate) must be held at least twice.
② Oral examination score sheet
- Applicant name: yourself
- Date: date of the final review
- Print 5 copies and place them at the committee professors' seats in advance.
③ Ballot
- Applicant name: yourself
- Print 5 copies and place them at the committee professors' seats in advance.
④ Dissertation review summary
- Print 1 copy for confirmation by the committee chair (write the summary in advance in consultation with your professor).
⑤ Dissertation review result table
- Print 1 copy for confirmation by the committee.
⑥ Abstract (write your student ID and name at the top; if the main text is in Korean, write a foreign-language abstract; if it is in a foreign language, write a Korean abstract). See <Attachment 3: Dissertation Writing Guidelines and Forms>.
⑦ Prepare the dissertation cover and approval page; see <Attachment 2>.
- One of the copies submitted to the library must include an "approval page" bearing the seals (a stamp or signature) of all committee members (prepare an ink pad), so print about 2–3 pages in advance on the day and obtain the seals.
* The dissertation title and writing language in the review result documents become the final dissertation title and cannot be changed later.
* Approval page dates: upper part ("Submitted." / November 2026), lower part ("Approved." / December 2026).

3. Public doctoral dissertation presentations (see the attached schedule, updated in real time)
- The doctoral dissertation (initial review) is held as a public presentation.

4. Submission of the degree (archival) dissertation
1) Submission guidelines: follow the Dissertation Writing Guidelines and Forms; see <Attachment 3>.
2) Online submission of the dissertation (PDF full-text file): Friday, January 15, 2027 to Monday, February 1, 2027, 14:00
- Submit only the online PDF full-text file; no bound copy is submitted.
- Central Library website (http://library.snu.ac.kr) → "Library Services" (도서관서비스) → "Online Dissertation Submission" (학위논문 온라인 제출).
- Submission enquiries: Central Library Digital Services Office (contact details are in the original notice).
- No submission or correction after the deadline.
- If you do not submit the dissertation, you cannot receive the degree.
3) The submission method and related details will be announced separately later.
4) Online dissertation submission confirmation and approval page (original)
- Submission period and place: Friday, January 15, 2027 to Monday, February 1, 2027, 14:00, to the department office (Room 117).
- How to obtain the online dissertation submission confirmation:
* Print it yourself: Central Library website (http://library.snu.ac.kr) → "Library Services" (도서관서비스) → "Online Dissertation Submission" (학위논문온라인제출) → "Archive" (자료실) (after submitting the full-text file).
* If you have unreturned books or overdue fees, they must be paid in full before you can print it.
5) Other
- Measure for those who do not submit: exclusion from the list of degree recipients.
- Dissertations are accepted only within the period and cannot be replaced after submission.
- The dissertation title and writing language must be those entered when submitting the dissertation review result documents (no changes afterwards).
- Submission by a proxy is possible, but the formal requirements must be met (approval page, consent form, etc.).
- For the issuance of the diploma, you must check your English name (upper and lower case) once more on the portal.
* How to enter or correct it: SNU portal (http://my.snu.ac.kr) → Student Administration → Personal Information → Edit Basic Personal Information (enter and correct English name).
- Detailed instructions on dissertation submission will follow a separate official notice from the Central Library to be issued later; please also refer to the Central Library website.
* See the attached Dissertation Writing Guidelines and Forms.

<Reference Schedule>
[Submission of dissertation review result report documents] by Tuesday, December 29, 2026
[Request for extension of the dissertation review period (only doctoral students who will extend their review to the next semester)] by Tuesday, December 29, 2026
[Request for extension of the dissertation submission deadline] by Tuesday, December 29, 2026
1. Students admitted in 2013 or earlier: students for whom 6 years (excluding military service) have passed since completing the doctoral program and who wish to extend by a further 2 years.
2. Students admitted in 2014 or later: students for whom 5 years (excluding military service) have passed since completing the doctoral program.
* School internal rule: as a principle, the permitted deadline for submitting a dissertation is up to 5 years after completing the program (the period of military service is not counted). [Established November 1, 2013]
[Online submission of the full-text file to the library] Friday, January 15, 2027 to Monday, February 1, 2027, 14:00

<Enquiries> Department of Aerospace Engineering office (contact details are in the original notice).
